description: A React Native component for rendering individual setting items in a settings screen, supporting various input types, feature gating, and navigation.

classes.name: _SectionItem
classes.description: React component for rendering a setting item with various input types and feature gating.

methods.name: checkIsFeatureAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a feature is available; if not, presents a paywall sheet.

methods.name: onChangeSettings
methods.description: Handles toggling of switch-type settings, updating state and calling optional callbacks.

methods.name: updateInput
methods.description: Updates the native input component with a new value.

methods.name: onChangeInputSelectorValue
methods.description: Handles input change for numeric input selectors, enforcing min/max bounds.
